variableContract.person: real identity may change but face stays roughly x18-47%, y34-58%; guide identity may change but remains white-filled oversized right-side figure, leaning and pointing to object
variableContract.text: wording may change but remains two left-aligned black lines, preferably four Han characters each, x1-44%, y6-24%, second line slightly larger
variableContract.product: held evidence object and lower scenario may change to industry-specific objects; preserve small object at finger target, foreground scenario scale, edge interlacing and causal relationship
variableContract.color: exact hues may change; preserve pale neutral title field, warmer/mid-dark photo backboard, brightest large white drawing and darkest title/outline

invariantContract.layout: headline x1-44%, y6-24%; real face x18-47%, y34-58%; guide x55-100%, y7-84%; held object x51-66%, y50-72%; drawn scenario x14-60%, y69-89%; quiet lower 9-12%
invariantContract.visualMass: guide largest shape at right; real person about 30-38% perceived weight; visible title area 13-17%; drawing fill about 18-25%; bottom scenario bridges both halves
invariantContract.specialEffects: solid white hand-drawn guide and lower scenario with variable near-black outlines; real held object and some real foreground details cross drawing boundaries; clean photo/drawing hard-edge collage without thick shadow
